meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 制作视频时，在没有专用流程的情况下，会用它来设计并生成自定义视频构图，适合多场景影片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇等。
howto.when: 当视频任务没有更专用的流程可用，或 BRIEF.md 的 flow 设为 companion 时，此技能接管。

say.text: 帮我制作一个多场景的品牌宣传片，节奏快一点
say.note: Claude 会规划并构建多场景视频。

say.text: 把这几段素材混剪成一支音乐视频
say.note: Claude 会处理素材并加入转场动画。

say.text: 创建一个静态标题卡用于片头
say.note: Claude 会生成静止的标题画面。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when making a video with no dedicated workflow, Claude uses this skill to design and build custom video compositions for multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no more specific workflow fits a video task, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion.

say_en.text: Make me a multi-scene brand film with a fast pace
say_en.note: Claude plans and builds the multi-scene video.

say_en.text: Remix these clips into a music video
say_en.note: Claude processes footage and adds transitions.

say_en.text: Create a static title card for the intro
say_en.note: Claude generates a still title frame.
